title: The same release build starts on both machines
steps: Install the same zip on both machines and launch through Steam.
eye: The title screen shows no error and Settings > Archipelago is there on both machines.

title: The host connects to the server
steps: Host a new save with the server's address and slot name, press Test connection, then Continue.
eye: Test connection answers in words, and the corner of the screen shows the connection.

title: A guest joins and is recognised
steps: Join from the second machine.

text: runs the mod; mirroring the overlay

eye: The guest's screen shows the host's connection line.

title: A guest leaves and comes back
steps: Leave with the guest, come back, look at the gourds and gadgets in the hub.

text: runs the mod; mirroring the overlay

eye: Nothing is doubled or missing on the guest's screen.

title: A guest on another build is told so
steps: Join once with another build of the mod, then once without it. Leave these two guest logs out of record.
eye: Both cases show a message, and neither game crashes.

title: A check made by the host reaches the server
steps: Solve a puzzle with the host.
eye: The server lists the check once.

title: A check made by a guest reaches the server
steps: Cut a big key and place it, with the guest doing both.
eye: The server lists the cuts and the placement once each.

title: A gourd received during play
steps: Send a Gourd from the server's console.
eye: Both screens show it in the same place, and either player can carry it and deposit it.

title: A gadget received during play
steps: Send a Megaphone from the server's console.
eye: Both screens show it, and the island's own gadgets of that kind are gone.

title: A big key and its door received
steps: Send the Map Room's key and the Map Room from the server's console; carry the key to its plinth.
eye: The key is tinted on both screens, and the door is open for both.

title: Gourds deposited in a monument
steps: Deposit gourds until a deposit check goes out, one of them with the guest.
eye: The monument shows them on both screens and the server lists the deposit check.

title: Towers in order
steps: On a tower_mode: by_item seed, send a Progressive Monument.
eye: Only the towers opened so far take gourds, on both machines.

title: Abilities locked until received
steps: On a lock_abilities seed, try throwing, sitting and carrying with both players, then send Throwing.
eye: The locked actions are refused for both players, and throwing works for both after its item.

title: Puzzle parts hidden until received
steps: On a lock_puzzle_needs seed, find a puzzle without its buttons, then send Buttons.
eye: The buttons are missing then back on both screens, and the puzzle can be solved.

title: A trap played for everyone
steps: Send a Big Confetti and one trap from the server's console.
eye: Both players get each effect, and both are over at the end.

title: The host's tiles and sounds reach the guest
steps: Put a PNG and a WAV in the host's tiles folder, then join with the guest.
eye: The guest sees the drawing on the tiles and hears the sound.

title: The hub's boards and the map
steps: With tracker_board and map_tracker: all, ask for a hint at the sign, then do the hinted check.
eye: The hinted check has a gold pin on both maps, and leaves the map once done.
The right sign counts the checks left.

title: The seed's colours
steps: On a random_colors seed, look at the buoys, the flare guns and a flare.
eye: Both screens show the same colours.

title: The highest point objective
steps: On a seed with big_climb, go to the Peak fireworks.

text: is done: a player is at

eye: The board in the hub ticks it.

title: The server stops and comes back
steps: Stop the server, make a check, start the server again.

text: check(s) already validated on this save.

eye: The game goes on without the server, and the check made meanwhile reaches it.

title: A save loaded again
steps: Quit to the menu and host the same save again.
eye: Nothing is received twice, and the gourds not deposited are back in the hub.

title: The goal is reported
steps: Reach the goal of a short seed.
eye: The server shows the slot as done.

title: A config file from the last release
steps: Start once with the .cfg of the last release.
eye: The settings kept their values and the ones that are gone left the file.

title: No flood of errors
steps: Look at the logs of everything above.
